title: Fig Asks for Help at the Barn
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ou as u, ear as er, or as er.

pages.brief: A huge fallen leaf propped up against the entrance of an old barn, blocking the way in.
Fig the caterpillar pulling hard at one edge of the enormous leaf.
Fig the caterpillar straining, the huge leaf staying exactly where it is.
Fig the caterpillar stepping back, looking at the leaf and then at the closed path ahead.
Fig the caterpillar calling over to Ned the duckling and Moss the hedgehog nearby.
Ned the duckling and Moss the hedgehog hurrying over to join Fig at the barn gate.
Fig, Ned and Moss all gripping different edges of the huge leaf together.
The three of them pulling together, the big leaf sliding away from the barn gate.
The barn entrance now completely clear, the leaf pushed off to one side.
Fig, Ned and Moss standing together at the open barn gate, all smiling.
